title: UploadResult
description: `POST /files/upload`: `200` when every item was written, `207` when any failed, each with its own outcome. In the domain `items` is a discriminated union by `status` (`created`/`renamed` carry `etag`; `replaced` carries `etag` and `history`; `failed` carries `error`), which the generator cannot express as a `oneOf`; flattened here, with the pairing documented per field (plan 28, B-48).

history.description: How keeping the version it replaced in the local history ended. Present exactly when `status` is `replaced`.

error.description: Present exactly when `status` is `failed`. The envelope of an error, without the parts that belong to a whole response.

params.description: Open: the parameters of the message, by key.
